title: Create any Roommate
description:
(IS🎭) Share an apartment with anyone you want. 

You describe the roommate (which can also include characters from fiction). Just give them a name and a description. Eg:
- Emily: Emily is a female streamer who thrives on attention and control.
- Caleb: Caleb is a softly spoken male law student who is attentive to the point of obsession.
- Alex: Alex is a blonde female marketing assistant who enjoys playful conversation and teasing.
- Harley: Harley Quinn.

You can even use this scenario to create your own monster girl roommate if you wish.

Use the question about additional themes to shape the direction of your story to be comedic, romantic, silly, gritty, realistic or anything else you want.

I developed this as my own template to play about with Inner Self. I wasn’t intending to release it but, as I’ve had a lot of use out of it, I’ve polished it and released it for anyone that wants to use it. 

——————————————————————————

Includes the amazing Inner Self script by @LewdLeah which adds  inner thoughts and character depth for NPCs. Auto-Cards by @LewdLeah also included. Thanks again, Leah 🙏

You can find more information on Inner Self here - https://play.aidungeon.com/scenario/tsu1WMJXaaAZ/inner-self?share=true 

NOTE: INNER SELF AND AUTO-CARDS ARE NOT COMPATIBLE WITH ATLAS AND RAVEN

To turn on auto-cards, open the “Configure Inner Self” story card in your adventure and edit the line > Install Auto-Cards to state “true” instead of “false”.
